name: trading-platform
description: Convenience shortcuts only. Every deployable is self-contained: nothing here is required to build, run or deploy any of them.

scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; pnpm db:up && pnpm exchange:db && { pnpm exchange:run & pnpm simulator start & pnpm backend start & pnpm market-data start & pnpm newswire start & pnpm web dev; }
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f broker/compose.yml down -v && pnpm db:up && pnpm --dir broker/backend db:migrate && pnpm --dir broker/backend db:seed && pnpm --dir broker/market-data db:migrate
scripts.spec:sync: pnpm --dir broker/backend spec:sync && pnpm --dir broker/market-data spec:sync && pnpm --dir participants/simulator spec:sync && pnpm --dir participants/newswire spec:sync
scripts.spec:check: pnpm --dir broker/backend spec:check && pnpm --dir broker/market-data spec:check && pnpm --dir participants/simulator spec:check && pnpm --dir participants/newswire spec:check
